mono-4629.d: Deer, an ink painting by Katsushika Hokusai (1615-1868) from the National Museum of Asian Art, printed as a one-ink halftone. History, worn lightly.
mono-4629.c: Katsushika Hokusai, National Museum of Asian Art

mono-4638.d: Winterberry (Ilex verticillata), a botanical study by Mary Vaux Walcott (1920) from the Smithsonian American Art Museum, printed as a one-ink halftone. Old work, printed new.
mono-4638.c: Mary Vaux Walcott, Smithsonian American Art Museum

mono-4663.d: Design for a Tureen, an ornament print by Joseph Anton Seethaler II (1825-1835) from the Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum, its marks printed as one ink. The original's marks, nothing added.
mono-4663.c: Joseph Anton Seethaler II, Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum

mono-4700.d: Chickadee, a print by Charles E. Heil (ca. 1923) from the Smithsonian American Art Museum, its marks printed as one ink. An archive piece, off the wall and onto a tee.
mono-4700.c: Charles E. Heil, Smithsonian American Art Museum
